csv_project_name: DB Svc for Retail Grocery & Commercial Kitchen
csv_scope_of_work: Request for Proposals for DB Services. The Ticonderoga Natural Foods Cooperative, Inc. invites proposals from design-build construction firms for the renovation of its 1,910 sq. ft. ground-floor retail grocery and commercial kitchen. The project scope includes: new storefront facade, completion of commercial kitchen, interior reconfiguration to include cafe seating, energy efficiency upgrades, electrical upgrades and safe rear egress linking to McCormick Street and the River Walk.
